title: Housing Price Index Overview
text:
Welcome to the Housing Price Index project. This homepage visualizes decades of quarterly home valuation changes across all U.S. states and metropolitan areas.
#| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
df <- read_csv(“data/hpi_master.csv”)
ggplot(df, aes(x = yr, y = index_nsa)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.2, color = “#2563eb”) + theme_minimal() + labs( title = “U.S. House Price Index Trends (1975–Present)”, subtitle = “Data points representing over 100,000 observations”, x = “Year”, y = “House Price Index (Base 100)” )

title: Housing Price Index Overview
text:
Welcome to my Housing Price Index project! This website explores how housing prices have changed over time using thousands of observations from across the United States.














Use the Exploration tab to examine patterns in the data and the Story tab to learn about important housing market trends.
